description: Links an app to a GitHub repo and syncs, commits or unlinks it. Sync only pulls into pre and deletes files gone from the repo. More: neblla_get_llms tools/git

action.description: sync pulls into pre and deletes removed files; example publishes pro to the public repo

appId.description: The app public ID (not needed for "repos" / "branches")

branch.description: For link: pre's branch, the one to follow (default

deletes.description: For "commit": paths to delete in the same commit

files.description: For "commit": the files to write, all in one commit

proBranch.description: For link: pro's branch, written only by neblla_promote (default "neblla-pro")

subdir.description: For link: folder inside the repo that holds the app (default "dist"
